o: Prepare for an electrifying, once in a lifetime concert experience as Prince commands the stage in 3121 Las Vegas Live. At the height of his legendary Las Vegas residency, Prince delivers a breathtaking showcase of unparalleled musicianship, explosive energy, dazzling guitar work, and unforgettable performances. Blending funk, rock, soul, R&B, and pop, he tears through hits, fan favorites, deep cuts, and extended jams with the spontaneity and brilliance that defined Prince as one of the greatest performers of all time. Whether you've been a lifelong Prince fan or are discovering his genius for the first time, this is Prince unleashed, and an essential experience for every generation.
